contents.text: The request comes back as a clear card, not a wall of text. It lists the room, the nights, the guests and a way to reach the guest. Its status says not sent yet, so you see it before anything goes anywhere.

choices.label: It asks before it sends
choices.why: The third stop: nothing leaves the page until the visitor says yes.

choices.label: Explain another section
choices.why: Pick any part of the page by its name.

choices.label: Stop here
choices.why: We can pick this up another time.
